scope: Independent bounded exact-commit source and existing FP microguest raw-artifact review. No native/VM/input action, download, source modification or commit by reviewer.
summary: The exact publisher-named commit is now locally readable and its relevant Git objects are verified. This closes the previous unavailable-source gap for this review, but not compiler/configuration/dependency/dirty-tree or binary-build reproducibility gaps.

Stock TCG has modeling and save/restore defects as well as export gaps: FOP is not updated by reviewed TCG x87 execution; FXSAVE leaves its two output bytes untouched and zeros pointer/selector blocks; FNSTENV exports nonzero pointers/selectors but no FOP. Missing fields cannot be repaired by zeros, a more elaborate parser or opcode inference alone.

The real frozen binary microguest confirms those export behaviors with A5 sentinels, actual nonzero FIP/FDP and ST0=3.0. It is a negative capability result and does not admit Windows/full57 acquisition.

primary_source.reference_rule: All source line references below are from this exact commit; not upstream approximation. The existing binary reports this commit, but source identity alone is not source-to-binary equivalence.

exact_source_findings.finding: Model stores fpuc/fpus/fpstt, physical fpregs[8], empty-only fptags[8], fpop/fpcs/fpds/fpip/fpdp. Translator updates FDP offset and selected segment on relevant memory operations and updates FIP/CS on applicable x87 operations; no corresponding fpop update exists in this TCG path.

Exact-tree grep of env.fpop assignments finds accelerator bridges and generic xsave helper, not TCG arithmetic translator/helper updates. FNINIT clears pointers/selectors but does not reset fpop. Serialized env.fpop can therefore be stale or initial data; existing storage is not evidence of maintained architectural opcode.

32-bit FNSTENV writes FIP at+12, a32-bit zero-extended fpcs at+16, FDP at+20 and fpds at+24. Thus FOP position+18 is zero, not env.fpop. 16-bit output has different widths. The helper also has no exception-mask update; the present all-masked microguest does not dynamically test that additional architectural side effect.

do_xsave_fpu writes FCW/FSW/abridgedFTW, never writes legacy.fpop(+6), explicitly writes zeroQWORD at+8 and+16, and stores logicalST(i) payloads. BothFXSAVE and relevantXSAVE paths call this helper. A5A5 is untouched caller memory, not an architectural FOP.

FLDENV restores control/status/empty-tag information only; FXRSTOR/XRSTOR x87 helper restores control/status/tags andST payloads, not FIP/FDP/FCS/FDS/FOP. Correct export alone cannot provide lossless restoration.

RSP reads logicalST(i) using TOP, but writes fpregs[n] directly; nonzeroTOP requires a corrected round-trip contract. FPTAG/pointers/selectors/FOP read slots are constant placeholders and corresponding writes are ignored.

CPU version12 serializes physicalFP80, normalizedFSW and physical abridgedFTW, segments/table caches, controls, DR[8], MXCSR/XMM. Optional cpu/fpop_ip_dp carriesfpop/fpip/fpdp but omitsfpcs/fpds. Migration does not fix modeledFOP or lossless selector recovery. Absent subsection zero semantics require exact version-complete parsing, not heuristic omission defaults.

fptags retains only empty/nonempty. Full two-bit tag is reconstructed from physicalFP payload. Arbitrary FLDENV-loaded valid/zero/special tag encodings are collapsed to nonempty; a complete raw full-tag round-trip claim requires preserving or explicitly validating/rejecting such states.

Guest MOVDR4/5 aliasesDR6/7 whenCR4.DE=0; whenDE=1 it raises#UD. GD adds#DB side effects. Serialized env.dr[4]/[5] are internal array slots, not independently guest-readable architectural values. Never export unused slots as canonicalDR4/5 or silently fillzeros.

TCG maintains lazy condition codes during execution; use synchronized/materialized flags, not arbitraryenv.eflags reads midTB. HMP prints some bases/control fields at32bit depending onmode. A new raw host exporter must retain full widths and explicit mode, with allVPs stopped at one epoch.

TCG supportedEBX mask does not include FDP_EXCPTN_ONLY or ZERO_FCS_FDS. The probe observed CPUID7.0EBX=0. No claim that this run architecturally advertises unconditional-zero selectors or exception-only pointer validity is available.
The generic host xsave helper does copyenv.fpop and pointer fields. It is not the TCG guestFXSAVE helper and cannot manufacture missing TCG updates; do not confuse similarly named codepaths.

canonical57_source_plan.group: EAX..EIP/EFLAGS/CS DS ES FS GS SS/CR0 CR2 CR3 CR4/GDTR IDTR LDTR TR
canonical57_source_plan.required: Capture synchronized modelGPRs, materialized flags and full descriptor caches directly from stoppedVP, with mode and full base widths preserved; reject unsupported truncation.

Record raw physicalFP80+TOP+empty mask and define canonicalFP order explicitly. FullFPTAG cannot always be recovered solely from payload after arbitrary tag loads; fix model or reject that state class.
Repair maintained opcode and relevant save/load/reset lifecycle; export maintained full-width values and selectors. ExistingFNSTENV is a useful negative-test cross-check, not a complete observer.
Synchronize lazySSE status before capture and retain all128bits; test nontrivial lanes/control/exceptions. No zero initialization substitute.
DR0..3/6/7 are readable modeled state. DR4/5 need an explicit architecture-qualified alias/undefined policy verified against the existing canonical contract; raw internaldr4/dr5 is insufficient.

minimal_implementation_sequence: 1. Freeze exact basecommit and produce a separate source patch/build identity. Record compiler, toolchain/dependency versions, configure flags, generated config and binarySHA; do not relabel stock publisher binary as patched/reproduced.

2. Fix x87 state modeling before writing a parser: opcode decode/update/reset; protected/real/compat/64-bit FIP/FDP/selector/opcode save and restore; masking and pending-exception behavior; preserve fulltag semantics or declare supported/rejected state classes. A naive tail-store ofFOP is insufficient if an earlier helper faults or restores state.

3. Add one narrow versioned CPU-only host capture endpoint at a proven stopped-vCPU boundary. Export typed raw fields plusvalidity/mode/build/VP/epoch metadata, physicalFP order and descriptor64bit bases. Avoid guest-injected save instructions, host process-memory scans, RAM migration streaming and broad text parser fallback. This endpoint is proposed, not implemented here.

4. Define restoration separately: direct architectural fields must update hidden caches, lazyflags/SSE state and breakpoint configuration via correct model helpers; invalidate affectedTBs and re-read. Include nonzeroTOP to catch existingRSP read/write order mismatch. Never treat assigning a rawCPU struct as safe restoration.

5. Bound tests to owned microguests first: masked and unmasked x87 arithmetic; nonzero opcode/pointers/selectors; FXsave sentinel; FNSTENV/FLDENV andFXRSTOR roundtrip; nonzeroTOP+holes/specialvalues; selector/base widths above4GiB in supportedmodes; DR4/5 withDE0/DE1/GD; original#DB→IRETD behavior before and after capture. Untested cases stay rejected.

6. A complete57 data shape is not complete machine continuation: exception/pending interrupt state, hidden segment/cache state, timing/device state, RAM and original resource ownership still require their own proof. Only after model/export/restore tests and source-build identity can a separateWindows admission decision be considered.
limitations: No new backend code, parser or restore implementation was created. The proposed steps are required work, not completed capabilities.

The microguest tests32-bit protectedmode, oneVP, one all-masked x87 arithmetic path. No64bit/compatibility pointer roundtrip, pendingunmasked exception, arbitrarytag load or hardware differential was run here.
No executable source-to-binary reproducible-build closure. Exact source objects and behavior agreement are stronger than previousupstream approximation but do not prove every byte came from thattree.
DR4/5 may make the current57 contract incompatible with an all-independent-register interpretation. Resolve semantics explicitly; do not change frozenvalidator or silently normalizealiases.
Successfulprocess exit and valid544B source only show negative capability probe completion. They do not certify fullstate/fullABI/Windows/game lifetimes.
retention: Only one new small JSON. Existing source.git and raw probe artifacts were read in place; no duplicate source tree, ELF, binary or trace saved by reviewer.
